itemized.notes: INDEPENDENT RE-READ (2026-08-18 close-out leg). The 2026-08-14 record for this key was withdrawn for geometry defects; that quarantined record was NOT opened and no value was carried from it. Every figure was read fresh off the 200 dpi full-page renders and every band was re-measured and crop-proved. FORM ORDER is the conventional one: p2 = Form A, p3 = Form B. Typed form; candidate and committee secretary are the same person (Leann Kilts) and both signed Oct 27, 2014; RECEIVED stamp OCT 27 2014. THIS IS A PERIOD-SCOPED FILING: the cover's Totals From Last Report column is populated on every line (11,529.11 / 297.45 / 11,826.56 / 0.00), so both schedules itemize only the reporting period and both sides are period-exact, not exact. AMOUNT TYPOGRAPHY: this filer writes ragged decimals -- Form A amounts carry no decimal places at all ('100', '1000') and Form B mixes one-place and two-place figures ('28.5', '99.8', '43.2', '25'). All are transcribed VERBATIM as printed and none was normalised to two places; they sum to the printed totals exactly as written. PRIVACY: Form A prints a full street address in a single Address cell for every donor; only the city/state component is carried, per PRIVACY.md. The address cell is free text and the filer was inconsistent -- two donors have a city with no state and three have 'Ogden Ut' -- so two rows carry a BLANK donor_state that reflects the FILER's omission, not a county redaction. Form B has a City column but no state column, so vendor_state is blank BY THE FORM on all 13 rows. Row 6 of Form B is a payment TO the city of Plain City for park use, so vendor and city are legitimately the same string. Cover line 2's This-Report cell is a bare dash -- a NIL MARK, left BLANK per the zero-glyph ruling, never 0 -- while the line-4 Last-Report cell is a typed '0.00' and is a real zero; the two are different facts on the same cover.
